toll.note: The Toll Tower's pulse: one deep church bell struck hard (prime D3, its nominal an octave up), a thud under the strike, ringing out over a second and a half.

clap.note: The Clapper Tower's strike: a heavy clapper on a bronze bell, a short clang over a low thud, damped quickly.

chime.note: The Chime Post: two bronze chime tubes touching, D6 then G6, a bright shimmer that fades.

bees.note: The Beekeeper's bees: a swarm of seven buzzing voices round 210 Hz, each with its own wingbeat vibrato and drift, swelling in and away.

match_found.note: Match Found: three hand bells rising (C5, E5, G5) over a soft low bell, an inviting peal that rings out.
